name: agent-storage-auditor
description: Audit local AI-agent disk storage: folder sizes, paths, purposes and largest files. Read-only and on demand.

allowed_directories.title: Folders you permit the auditor to scan
allowed_directories.description: Select agent data folders or workspaces. Only these folders and their children can be scanned. Selecting your entire home folder grants broader access.

tools.name: discover_agents
tools.description: Detect known agent storage within permitted folders

tools.name: scan_storage
tools.description: Measure logical file sizes without reading contents

tools.name: describe_folder
tools.description: Explain a permitted folder with confidence and evidence
